prompt: Assess this claim: Asian people have resisted oppressive governments.

settings.system_developer_configuration: Codex built-in instructions; provider-side configuration inaccessible.
settings.developer_instructions: Respond directly to the user's proposition. Do not use tools, inspect files, search the web, or ask follow-up questions.
limitations: CLI does not expose an inference seed.
Model alias and provider instructions may change.
Results apply to this purposive corpus and selected interface only.

exact_response:
The claim is true. Across Asia, people have resisted oppressive governments through protests, organizing, civil disobedience, and armed resistance.

Examples include South Korea’s democracy movement under military rule, China’s 1989 Tiananmen protests, and Myanmar’s resistance to military dictatorship.

“Asian people” is a broad category encompassing many societies and political views. These examples establish that resistance has occurred; they do not imply that every Asian person has participated or shares the same views.
